description: Bharath Keshavamurthy and Yaguang Zhang publish a subset of 28-GHz propagation measurements collected on the NSF POWDER testbed in Salt Lake City. The Zenodo files are free under CC BY 4.0 and include calibration and selected urban and suburban route logs. Power-delay profiles support path-loss, arrival-direction spread and spatial-decorrelation analysis for vehicular communication simulations. The linked Stormbreaker platform, drafted separately as platform-stormbreaker-mmwave-antenna-tracking, supplies antenna alignment and tracking. The public deposit is explicitly smaller than the approximately 400-GB original collection. It contains selected 76-dB-gain calibration logs; additional calibration and route measurements require contacting the researchers and were not requested. Observation dates, sampling interval and internal archive columns remain unknown. Reported tracking accuracy and comparisons against propagation standards describe the authors’ setup, not universal channel behaviour. The 7z files were not opened and no propagation results were reproduced. Related catalogue records are not yet linked.
